scriptLines: bronzeDrivers derive(driverId = iif(isNull(driverId) || trim(driverId) == '' || upper(trim(driverId)) == 'NULL' || upper(trim(driverId)) == 'N/A' || trim(driverId) == '\\N', toString(null()), trim(driverId)),
driverRef = iif(isNull(driverRef) || trim(driverRef) == '' || upper(trim(driverRef)) == 'NULL' || upper(trim(driverRef)) == 'N/A' || trim(driverRef) == '\\N', toString(null()), trim(driverRef)),
number = iif(isNull(number) || trim(number) == '' || upper(trim(number)) == 'NULL' || upper(trim(number)) == 'N/A' || trim(number) == '\\N', toString(null()), trim(number)),
code = iif(isNull(code) || trim(code) == '' || upper(trim(code)) == 'NULL' || upper(trim(code)) == 'N/A' || trim(code) == '\\N', toString(null()), trim(code)),
forename = iif(isNull(forename) || trim(forename) == '' || upper(trim(forename)) == 'NULL' || upper(trim(forename)) == 'N/A' || trim(forename) == '\\N', toString(null()), trim(forename)),
surname = iif(isNull(surname) || trim(surname) == '' || upper(trim(surname)) == 'NULL' || upper(trim(surname)) == 'N/A' || trim(surname) == '\\N', toString(null()), trim(surname)),
dob = iif(isNull(dob) || trim(dob) == '' || upper(trim(dob)) == 'NULL' || upper(trim(dob)) == 'N/A' || trim(dob) == '\\N', toString(null()), trim(dob)),

nationality = iif(isNull(nationality) || trim(nationality) == '' || upper(trim(nationality)) == 'NULL' || upper(trim(nationality)) == 'N/A' || trim(nationality) == '\\N', toString(null()), trim(nationality))) ~> limpiarTodo
limpiarTodo derive(forename = iif((forename == lower(forename) || forename == upper(forename)), replace(initCap(lower(replace(forename, '-', '~ '))), '~ ', '-'), forename),
surname = iif((surname == lower(surname) || surname == upper(surname)), replace(initCap(lower(replace(surname, '-', '~ '))), '~ ', '-'), surname),

nationality = case(isNull(nationality), 'Unknown', lower(nationality) == 'argentinian', 'Argentine', (nationality == lower(nationality) || nationality == upper(nationality)), replace(initCap(lower(replace(nationality, '-', '~ '))), '~ ', '-'), nationality)) ~> normalizarTextos

normalizarTextos derive(dob = case(regexMatch(dob, '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'), toDate(dob, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), regexMatch(dob, '^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}$'), toDate(dob, 'dd/MM/yyyy'), regexMatch(dob, '^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{4}$'), toDate(dob, 'MM-dd-yyyy'), regexMatch(dob, '^[0-9]{4}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}$'), toDate(dob, 'yyyy/MM/dd'), regexMatch(dob, '^[0-9]{2}-[A-Za-z]{3}-[0-9]{4}$'), toDate(dob, 'dd-MMM-yyyy'))) ~> convertirFecha
